name: Wolves Across the Border
summary: In Northshire Valley, Eagan Peltskinner asks you to hunt wolves and bring him their meat. He waits outside Northshire Abbey, where daily needs remain even as guards focus on Defias bandits.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Request
sections.body: Eagan Peltskinner waits by Northshire Abbey’s walls, angry at the local timber wolves. Marshal McBride and the Stormwind guards have little strength to defend the abbey from Defias bandits. Tradesfolk still have daily needs, so Eagan asks you to thin the wolves’ numbers and bring back their tough meat for his cooking.

sections.title: Wilds of Northshire
sections.body: Wolves roam closer to Northshire Abbey as patrols weaken. The Kingdom of Stormwind has too few troops and lacks leadership. Young wolves and timber wolves prowl the abbey’s paths and orchards. Hunting them supplies Eagan’s pantry and makes nearby trails safer for novitiates, laborers, and newly arrived defenders.

faq.answer: Eagan Peltskinner is a hunter and tradesman near the entrance to Northshire Abbey. He dislikes the local timber wolves and is glad to cook and eat their meat.

faq.q: Why does Eagan want wolf meat?
aliases: what does eagan do with meat
faq.answer: Eagan enjoys eating wolf steaks. He offers useful starter gear and coin to recruits who bring him fresh meat.
Timber wolves and young wolves roam Northshire Valley’s fields, hills, and riverbanks, especially south and east of the abbey.

faq.q: Why are wolves a problem in Northshire?
faq.answer: Reduced patrols and Defias bandits have left Northshire’s roads and farms exposed to wildlife. Unescorted travel is dangerous for clergy and workers.

faq.q: Do I need to talk to anyone before taking this quest?
faq.answer: No. Deputy Willem may send newcomers to Eagan through an introductory errand, but Eagan offers the hunt directly to anyone who approaches him outside the abbey.

faq.q: Is tough wolf meat used for cooking recipes?
faq.answer: Eagan plans to cook the meat himself. Novitiate cooks often learn that wolf meat gathered in Elwynn Forest is a basic ingredient for outdoor cooking.

angles.text: As a cook, you learn a frontier truth from Eagan’s craving for wolf steak: what you hunt can often be cooked and eaten.
As a human recruit in Northshire, you find this among your first practical ways to help secure Stormwind’s nearby borders.
